experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 200 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r5, -1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.d $r7, $xr0, 0; and $r7, $r7, $r5; or $r7, $r7, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r7'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then xvpickve2gr.d+and+or+xvreplgr2vr.d to restore the input pattern; the 9-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 11-55 cycles, CPI 5.9912-28. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr8; xvfrsqrt.d $xr1, $xr9; xvfrsqrt.d $xr2, $xr10; xvfrsqrt.d $xr3, $xr11; xvfrsqrt.d $xr4, $xr12; xvfrsqrt.d $xr5, $xr13; xvfrsqrt.d $xr6, $xr14; xvfrsqrt.d $xr7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr8; xvfrsqrt.d $xr1, $xr9; xvfrsqrt.d $xr2, $xr10; xvfrsqrt.d $xr3, $xr11; xvfrsqrt.d $xr4, $xr12; xvfrsqrt.d $xr5, $xr13; xvfrsqrt.d $xr6, $xr14; xvfrsqrt.d $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput, 8 independent lanes. CPI ranges 5.9912-28 over the same 26-value sweep; the stored experiment uses 1.0.
